# Where do you sit on the 2026 Medicare IRMAA cliffs?

> Free 2026 Medicare IRMAA calculator: enter your MAGI from two years ago to see your Part B and Part D tier, the surcharge, how many dollars until the next cliff, how much Roth conversion fits under it, and an SSA-44 appeal checklist. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
